parts:
Hello R -group

After installing suggested packages I got the following warnings as shown below.


package 'splancs' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
package 'Ecdat' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
package 'misc3d' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
package 'geoR' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
package 'RandomFields' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
package 'tweedie' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
package 'miscTools' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
Error in gzfile(file, "r") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  downloaded length 621496 != reported length 663223
2: In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  downloaded length 621496 != reported length 738251
3: In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  downloaded length 3507574 != reported length 4348897
4: In unzip(zipname, exdir = dest) : error 1 in extracting from zip file
5: In gzfile(file, "r") :
  cannot open compressed file 'sets/DESCRIPTION', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

Regards
Lee

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re:
parts:
Hi Lee,

This looks like something I see on Windows when installing a large colleciton of packages - when I repeat the process I tend not to get the same error, or perhaps not in the same place. You might like to try again.

Regards,
Graham
